speaker: Doctor
text:
Please describe your medical history in detail, as your symptoms of gait and limb ataxia suggest a complex underlying condition. Have you ever been diagnosed with cancer, or have you experienced unexplained weight loss or night sweats?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, HIV_Status.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, have you developed any new neurological symptoms like numbness, tingling, or vision changes since starting the medication? Also, have you had any recent infections or fevers?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
